name: suspender close grip push up
description: A close-grip push-up with the feet in suspension straps. The unstable base increases the challenge for the triceps and core.
instructions: Place your feet in the foot cradles and set a high plank with your hands slightly narrower than shoulder-width.
Brace your core and bend your elbows close to your ribs to lower your chest.
Press through your hands to return to straight arms, keeping your body aligned.
